description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get. It includes an internal Node class and utility functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list class with methods to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding string data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of a specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: A private helper method to remove a node from the list by updating links.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: A companion object method that returns the last node in the list starting from head.
